svg.text: OD 12, length 20 (Y 0 to 20). Bore Ø6.2 from the back, stops 1
Front wall 1 thick with a Ø4 hole for the beam.
Top slot 3.4 wide, Y 4 to 18, cut through the top wall. The
head's M3 screw goes through it and pinches the laser.
Slides into the head's Ø12.4 bore, stops on the Ø8 lip. Laser:
Ø6 x 14 brass (5 V red dot).
1. Origin = center of the sleeve's front face. Sleeve runs back along +Y.
2. Printed holes come out ~0.2 small: test-print one hole first.
3. Print standing on its front face. Change ID only for a different laser.
